topic.title: Visual Reasoning Data, Training, and Evaluation
topic.overview: Visual reasoning requires a model to combine evidence in an image with a sequence of decisions or deductions. These papers investigate question answering, compositional tasks, visual thinking, reinforcement fine-tuning, and process rewards. A representative data-generation framework builds verifiable image questions and composes simpler questions into more demanding problems with reasoning traces.
topic.whyItMatters: High benchmark scores can conceal weaknesses in spatial understanding or evidence use. Training data and evaluation tasks must distinguish genuinely demanding visual reasoning from problems answerable through language patterns or familiar examples.
topic.evolution: Early representatives use memory and uncertain scene representations for visual question answering. More recent work trains and verifies intermediate reasoning, sometimes using drawing or image tokens. Adversarially filtered benchmarks seek longer-lasting difficulty, while large synthetic datasets investigate how supervision and reinforcement learning affect transfer.
openQuestions: How can visual reasoning traces be checked for grounded correctness?
Can difficult benchmarks retain representative coverage as models adapt to them?

papers.title: Reliable Thinking with Images
papers.tldr: RTWI assesses, filters, and votes over intermediate visual and textual reasoning to reduce error accumulation in image-based thinking.

papers.title: RSAgent: Learning to Reason and Act via Multi-Turn Tool Invocations for Text-Guided Segmentation
papers.tldr: RSAgent improves text-guided segmentation by repeatedly using visual tools, observing feedback, and refining its target localization and masks.

papers.title: Scene Graph Thinking: Reinforcing Structured Visual Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.tldr: SaGe trains multimodal models with scene-graph reasoning traces and graph-based rewards, improving fine-grained visual reasoning across eight benchmarks.

papers.title: See First, Reason Later: Mutual Information-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language Models
papers.tldr: MIRL screens visual descriptions and rewards perception separately, improving vision-language reasoning while reducing complete-trajectory sampling.

papers.title: Seeing is Solving: Unlocking Efficient Multimodal RL via View Alignment
papers.tldr: FOCUS-RL uses text–vision alignment signals to guide training, reporting faster convergence and better multimodal reasoning accuracy.

papers.title: Seeing is Understanding: Unlocking Causal Attention into Modality-Mutual Attention for Multimodal LLMs
papers.tldr: Modality-mutual attention lets image tokens attend to text tokens, improving multimodal understanding without adding parameters.

papers.title: Self-Prophetic Decoding to Unlock Visual Search in LVLMs
papers.tldr: SeProD coordinates pre- and post-training models during decoding to improve visual search without further training or reported computational overhead.

papers.title: Semantic-Enriched Latent Visual Reasoning
papers.tldr: SLVR adds semantic attributes to visual latents and trains across related questions to improve reasoning robustness and consistency.

papers.title: SLQ: Bridging Modalities via Shared Latent Queries for Retrieval with Frozen MLLMs
papers.tldr: SLQ learns shared queries over a frozen multimodal model to produce strong retrieval embeddings while preserving backbone parameters.

papers.title: SPARC: Separating Perception And Reasoning Circuits for Test-time Scaling of VLMs
papers.tldr: SPARC separates visual search from reasoning so vision-language models can allocate inference computation more efficiently and improve visual-question answering.

papers.title: Spectral-Progressive Thought Flow for Lightweight Multimodal Reasoning
papers.tldr: SpecFlow progressively updates a fixed-size visual reasoning workspace, reducing computation and memory costs by up to 2.1 times.

papers.title: ST-Veto: Spatio-Temporal Token Veto for Diffusion MLLMs via Taylor Prediction and Visual Grounding
papers.tldr: ST-Veto improves multimodal diffusion reasoning by rejecting tokens with unstable confidence or weak visual grounding.

papers.title: Text Before Vision: Staged Knowledge Injection Matters for Agentic RLVR in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Understanding
papers.tldr: Teaching Earth-science reasoning through text before visual and tool-based training improves ultra-high-resolution remote-sensing understanding.

papers.title: The Abstraction Gap in Vision-Language Causal Reasoning
papers.tldr: CAGE separates fluent causal explanations from explicit causal chains, revealing large gaps in seven of eight evaluated vision-language models.

papers.title: The Art of Interrogation: Consistency Amplifies Factuality in Spatial Reasoning
papers.tldr: Training reasoning models for geometric and semantic consistency improves spatial reasoning without ground-truth labels.

papers.title: The Perceptual Bandwidth Bottleneck in Vision-Language Models: Active Visual Reasoning via Sequential Experimental Design
papers.tldr: FOVEA improves high-resolution visual reasoning through training-free, sequential crop refinement guided by a tractable proxy for information gain.

papers.title: Thinking in Latent Space: Progressive Multimodal Simplification for Visual Reasoning
papers.tldr: LDPVR alternates latent reasoning with targeted visual grounding to simplify textual states, improving accuracy while maintaining low inference latency.

papers.title: Token-Sparse Medical Multimodal Reasoning via Dual-Stream Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: ViToS jointly learns visual grounding and token-pruned medical reasoning, improving reported performance while retaining 77% of visual tokens.

papers.title: Training Data Efficiency in Multimodal Process Reward Models
papers.tldr: Balanced-Information Score selects informative reasoning rollouts, matching full-data reward-model performance with 10% of the training data in a reported result.

papers.title: TVI-CoT: Text-Visual Interleaved Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Multimodal Understanding
papers.tldr: TVI-CoT lets multimodal models alternate between reasoning and targeted visual access, improving results across eight evaluated benchmarks.

papers.title: Uncovering Grounding IDs: How External Cues Shape Multi-Modal Binding
papers.tldr: External visual cues induce latent Grounding IDs that improve image-text alignment, focus attention, and reduce hallucinations.

papers.title: Universal Skeleton Understanding via Differentiable Rendering and MLLMs
papers.tldr: SkeletonLLM learns to render skeleton motion into task-informative images, enabling multimodal language models to recognize, describe, and reason about motion across formats.

papers.title: Unlocking Zero-Shot Geospatial Reasoning via Indirect Rewards
papers.tldr: Geo-R1 uses geolocation-based indirect rewards to develop geospatial reasoning that transfers zero-shot across more than 25 downstream tasks.

papers.title: V-ABS: Action-Observer Driven Beam Search for Dynamic Visual Reasoning
papers.tldr: V-ABS improves multi-step visual reasoning by balancing planned-action confidence with execution feedback during beam search.

papers.title: Vision-aligned Latent Reasoning for Multi-modal Large Language Model
papers.tldr: VaLR inserts vision-aligned latent tokens before reasoning steps to preserve visual information and improve extended multimodal reasoning.

papers.title: VisionPulse: Dynamic Visual Sparsity for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
papers.tldr: VisionPulse dynamically retains a small, changing set of visual tokens during reasoning, reducing visual context and reasoning length with almost unchanged accuracy.

papers.title: Visual Para-Thinker: Divide-and-Conquer Reasoning for Visual Comprehension
papers.tldr: Visual Para-Thinker combines visual partitioning and independent parallel reasoning paths to improve multimodal visual comprehension.

papers.title: VisualPuzzles: Decoupling Multimodal Reasoning Evaluation from Domain Knowledge
papers.tldr: VisualPuzzles tests visual reasoning with little specialized knowledge, revealing human–model gaps and inconsistent benefits from additional thinking.

papers.title: VisualScore: Learning Holistic Visual Quality Scores via Multi-Task Reasoning
papers.tldr: VisualScore learns explanations and numerical image-quality scores across tasks while controlling reward conflicts during reinforcement learning.

papers.title: VR-Thinker: Boosting Video Reward Models through Think-with-Image Reasoning
papers.tldr: VR-Thinker actively gathers visual evidence during reasoning and achieves leading reported open-source accuracy on video preference benchmarks.

papers.title: VT-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Visual-Tabular Multi-Modal Learning
papers.tldr: VT-Bench standardizes visual-tabular prediction and reasoning evaluation across 14 datasets and assesses 23 representative models.

papers.title: ZeroBench: An Impossible Visual Benchmark for Contemporary Large Multimodal Models
papers.tldr: ZeroBench uses adversarially filtered visual questions to measure progress on tasks that frontier multimodal models initially failed completely.
